description: Design and implement multi-domain mail routing, shared mailboxes, and federated identity for stoa-mail and stoa-smtp. Covers virtual domain acceptance, Sieve-primary routing, mailbox types, OIDC multi-IdP identity model, SCIM provisioning, and trust-tiered access control. Designed for operators like the Linux Foundation / CNCF running many domains with complex staff/volunteer/contributor identity across multiple IdPs.
title: epic: multi-domain mail routing and identity
